description: Receipt Generation: Generate PDF receipts using expo-print with business info header, itemized sale details, payment breakdown, and totals. Enable sharing/printing via expo-sharing. Create receipt history screen for viewing past sales receipts.
steps: Create src/services/print/receiptTemplate.ts module. Export generateReceiptHTML(sale: SaleWithDetails, business: Business) function returning HTML string. Template structure: Business name (from business.name), location, phone at top centered. Horizontal line. Receipt number, date/time (formatDateTime). Horizontal line. Table: Item column (product name), Qty, Price (formatCurrency of unit_price), Total. Show all sale_items. Horizontal line. Subtotal, Discount (if > 0), Total (bold/larger). Horizontal line. Payments section: list each payment with method and amount. If cash, show 'Tendered' and 'Change'. Horizontal line. Footer: 'Thank you for your business!', 'Powered by DukaPOS'. Use inline CSS styling: font-family: monospace, max-width: 300px (from RECEIPT_CONFIG), font-size: 12px, padding. Center header/footer, left-align items table.

Create src/services/print/printService.ts. Export printReceipt(saleId: string) function. Steps: (1) Load sale with saleRepository.getSaleWithDetails(saleId). (2) Load business from businesses table (assume single business, query 'SELECT * FROM businesses LIMIT 1'). (3) Generate HTML with generateReceiptHTML(sale, business). (4) Use expo-print: const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({ html, width: RECEIPT_CONFIG.MAX_WIDTH }). (5) Return uri. Export shareReceipt(saleId: string) function calling printReceipt, then using expo-sharing: await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, { mimeType: 'application/pdf', dialogTitle: `Receipt ${sale.receiptNumber}` }).
Create src/hooks/useReceipt.ts with usePrintReceipt() mutation wrapping printService.printReceipt, useShareReceipt() mutation wrapping shareReceipt.

Create src/app/(tabs)/sales/[id].tsx screen for viewing sale receipt. Load sale with useSaleWithDetails(id) from route params. Display: Receipt number (large, bold), date/time, customer name (if any). Itemized list: product name, quantity, unit price, total per item. Subtotal, discount, total. Payment breakdown: method, amount. Two action buttons at bottom: 'Print Receipt' (calls usePrintReceipt), 'Share Receipt' (calls useShareReceipt). Show success toast after print/share.

Update POS checkout success flow in src/app/(tabs)/pos/checkout.tsx. After successful sale, navigate to sales/[id] receipt screen: router.push(`/sales/${saleId}`). User can share receipt with customer or print, then navigate back to POS.

Create src/app/(tabs)/sales/index.tsx screen for receipt history. List all sales ordered by created_at DESC using useSales(). Each row: receipt number, date (formatDate), total (formatCurrency), customer name (if any). Tap to view full receipt (navigate to sales/[id]). Add date range filter at top. Search by receipt number.
Add 'Sales History' navigation link to Dashboard or main menu. Ensure receipt screen is accessible from multiple entry points: post-checkout, sales history list, reports detail.
acceptance_criteria: generateReceiptHTML() produces valid HTML with business header, itemized sale items, totals, payment breakdown, and footer
HTML template uses inline CSS, monospace font, max-width 300px for receipt printer compatibility
printReceipt() uses expo-print to generate PDF, returns file URI
shareReceipt() uses expo-sharing to share PDF via system share sheet with appropriate MIME type
Sale receipt screen displays full sale details with itemized products, totals, and payments
Print and Share buttons on receipt screen trigger usePrintReceipt and useShareReceipt mutations successfully
After successful checkout, user navigates to receipt screen and can share receipt immediately
Sales history screen lists all sales with receipt number, date, total, customer, ordered newest first
Sales history screen has date range filter and receipt number search
Tapping any sale in history navigates to receipt detail screen
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and npx expo lint to confirm no errors
Complete a sale with multiple items and cash payment
Verify navigation to receipt screen after checkout shows correct receipt number, items, totals
Tap 'Share Receipt' button, verify system share sheet appears with PDF
Share PDF to email or messaging app, open PDF, verify formatting: business name at top, items in table, totals, payment info
Check PDF max width is 300px (appears narrow, suitable for thermal printers)
Navigate to Sales History screen, verify completed sale appears in list with correct receipt number and total
Tap sale from history, verify navigation to receipt detail screen
Search for receipt by receipt number (e.g., RCP-20240103-0001), verify filtering works
Apply date range filter to sales history, verify only sales within range appear
Complete sale with discount and mobile money payment, share receipt, verify discount line and mobile money payment details appear correctly in PDF
Enable airplane mode, view sales history and receipt, verify offline functionality (PDF generation may require online for fonts, test both)
